description: Modify a dashboard you own (owner-only). Replace the manifest or any metadata field; the version increments. Use this to edit a saved surface meaningfully — 'raise budgetUSD to 40', 'add a receipt window', 'make it public'. A replaced manifest must still conform to the schema and must not contain an API key. Only send the fields you want to change.

id.description: The id (ua_...) of the artifact to update.

manifest.description: Replacement DashboardManifest (must conform to the schema; no API key). Omit to leave the manifest unchanged.

visibility.description: New visibility (e.g. flip 'unlisted' -> 'public' to list it).

name: update_dashboard
